n-shared.text: Shared by every role. After sign-in the backend role decides which home opens (SRS 8.1.6). The case list, case detail and updates screens are one component each; the role only changes the data scope (SRS 5) and which actions show. Every value goes through display.ts: blanks read Not Available or Awaiting Update, never null or 0000-00-00 (9.3).

n-removed.text: Removed from earlier designs (out of SRS scope or needs VECV approval): escalate action and escalation portal (3.5, 20), CSM approval inbox (20), closure review and bulk closure (13.13, only if approved), SLA risk badges and SLA reports (10.4, 14.5), audit trail report (14.6, stays in web portal), BuyBack, Higher Assembly, Norms bulk close, app hub and role switcher, campaign banner, Top-10 dealer charts, CSV export, expandable list cards, permissions list, email case creation (7.16).

n-dealer.text: Dealer sees only own or dealer-mapped cases (SRS 5) and one support identity, PQMP Support, never desk names (4.2). Category, sub-category and dynamic fields come from the masters API (12.1), so the form follows the portal's field rules. Scan only assists: every scanned value can be edited and scan failure never blocks manual entry (6.6.8). The form keeps its input if submission fails (17.2.6).

n-track.text: Latest update sits at the top (8.5.2). Order, parts and tracking appear only for order-related cases and each carries Last refreshed (9.3.8). If SAP or logistics data fails, that section alone shows a plain fallback and the rest of the case still loads (11.9.1). Part status is derived from quantities: Fully, Partially, Not delivered, Under Review on mismatch (8.7). Reopen and feedback show only when the backend allows them.

n-desk.text: SRS 4.3: support desk mobile access needs VECV approval before release. Build after dealer. Desk sees assigned cases, dealer details and internal remarks, and can add remarks, update status, ask the dealer a question, upload files and close with final remarks (9.4.1). Remarks are internal unless marked visible to the dealer (SRS 5). No escalate action (Phase 2).

n-admin.text: SRS 7.15 and 13.12: view unassigned cases, cases by desk, desk workload, assign and transfer, old/pending cases. Every assignment and transfer is audited (8.10.2). The overdue and closure-eligible filters are left out until SLA and closure review are approved. Masters and configuration stay in the web portal (12.1). 7.15 also needs a technical discussion with VECV before build.

n-mgmt.text: Read-only reports within the user's approved data scope (SRS 4.5, 5.7): case summary 14.1, category 14.2, status 14.3, pending order cases 14.4, feedback 14.7, desk workload 14.8 and integration exceptions (4.5). Every tile drills down into the shared case list. Left out until approved: SLA and ageing 14.5, audit trail 14.6 (web portal), closure review summary 14.9.
